title: Funchi
description: Funchi is a dish from Aruba and Curaçao featuring cornmeal, queso fresco. This home-sized recipe records each ingredient at the step where it is used.

steps.instruction: Combine the listed ingredients in a bowl until evenly mixed; avoid overworking delicate components.
Combine the remaining ingredients, cover partly and stew gently for about 18 minutes until the flavors meld and everything is tender.
Shape, press or roll the prepared dough or mixture into portions appropriate to this dish.
Heat the pan over medium heat, shape or spoon out portions, and fry for about 12 minutes total until golden on both sides and fully cooked.
Finish with the listed ingredients, check seasoning and serve immediately.
